packageRules.description: One PR for all dependency updates, majors combined with minors (supersedes the old per-ecosystem non-major groups)

Keep the npm used for lockfiles below 12 (packageManager field). npm 12 defaults to allow-remote=none and Renovate's hosted sandbox then refused registry tarballs (EALLOWREMOTE), leaving package-lock.json stale on renovate/all (CI: lockfile out of sync). Lift once the sandbox issue is confirmed fixed.
